meta.name: self-evolve
meta.description: The single config quality skill. Two modes: (1) Default — review/wire pending self-improvement proposals. (2) Audit — analyzes skills, rules, CLAUDE.md, project refs, hooks, and agents against the actual codebase to find inaccuracies, trigger overlaps, stale references, and weak rules, then fixes them. Trigger on 'self-evolve', 'evolve', 'config health check', 'audit config', 'check claude setup', 'apply this rule', 'reorganize rules', 'ok' (when proposals are pending). NOT for improving individual skills (use skill-creator), diagnosing code bugs (use diagnose), or fixing broken code (use fix).
